title: Primavera Sound 2026 Livestream: Here’s Where to Watch Doja Cat, The Cure, Gorillaz & More Live Online
summary: Get livestream feeds of must-see festival performances starting Thursday (June 4) — watch online for free.
contentText:

Primavera Sound 2026 launches its online broadcast event this weekend, while this year’s music festival takes place at Parc del Fòrum in Barcelona, Spain.

On Thursday, June 4, until Saturday, June 6, Amazon Music livestreams Primavera Sound to give fans access to the festival, even if they’re not in Catalonia. For 2026, the headliners during the main festival days are Doja Cat, The Cure and The xx, while other must-see recording artist include Gorillaz, Geese, Blood Orange, Addison Rae, Skrillex, PinkPantheress, Rilo Kiley and others.

watch Primavera Sound 2026 on Prime Video

(Please note: The music festival officially runs for five days starting Wednesday, June 3, with performances from Wet Leg, Yard Act and others, and ending on Sunday, June 7, with Carl Cox and others. However, the first and final days of Primavera Sound aren’t available to livestream on Prime Video — just the main days of the music festival are streamable.)

To learn more about how you can livestream Primavera Sound for free , see below.

How to Watch Primavera Sound 2026 Online for Free

To livestream Primavera Sound, you’ll need a subscription to Amazon Music or Prime Video .

Primavera Sound 2026

watch on Prime Video

Livestream performances by Doja Cat, The Cure, The xx and others starting on Thursday, June 4.

Primavera Sound 2026 Festival Lineup

Primavera Sound, Day 1

Livestream performances by Doja Cat, Massive Attack, Bad Gyal, Geese and others.

For Thursday, June 4, the music festival livestream includes performances from Mac DeMarco, Father John Misty, TV Girl, Melt-Banana and Panda Bear.

Primavera Sound, Day 2

Livestream performances by The Cure, Addison Rae, Skrillex, PinkPantheress and others.

The livestream on Friday, June 5, features Ethel Cain, Role Model, JADE, Rilo Kiley, Viagra Boys, Slowdive, Cara Delevingne and Texas Is The Reason.

Primavera Sound, Day 3

Livestream performances by the XX, Gorillaz, my bloody valentine, Dijon and others.

And to close out the main days of the festival, on Saturday, June 6, you can livestream performances from Little Simz, Big Thief and MARINA. Check out the complete lineup here .

Livestream Primavera Sound 2026 on Prime Video starting Thursday, June 4, with a start time of 1:15 p.m. ET/10:15 a.m. PT.
